area: the Voyage map's HyperSea cells in the game
summary: HyperSeaCells, VoyageMapSky, VoyageEdgeGraphic and VoyageCellDraw now draw the cells as the board's uneven wet Kelvin foam (jittered BCC, power cells, knots, rounded outlines, per-cell nucleus at the cell's middle) instead of regular truncated octahedra, and the nucleus sprite is the game's white caged Nucleus look instead of the warm one; its five blues are traced into every colour set
why: Shombith took over Voyages and picked the wet foam on the board (PR #1972); this is the game port he chose
